result.summary: Found 3 visual issues, mainly content being clipped or obscured by fixed/scrolling layout elements.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the feed content. The second restaurant card image is partially hidden behind the bottom tab bar, making the card feel cut off and potentially harder to interact with.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content equal to the height of the bottom navigation so cards can scroll fully above it.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right edge, with the next chip only partially visible and no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-scroll treatment, such as consistent side padding, a fade edge, or ensure chips snap cleanly into view.

issues.description: Items in the “Fastest near you” carousel are cut off at the right edge, including the third restaurant card and its text, which looks visually cramped.
issues.suggestion: If this is intentional carousel peeking, add a fade/scroll cue and ensure text is not awkwardly clipped; otherwise adjust card widths and spacing to fit cleanly.
